Criteria.description: The complex condition and logical filter expressions that filter the results of the query.

DataSource.description: When set to 'archive', run the query against synapse storage for archived data.

Distinct.description: Whether the results of the query contain duplicate entity instances.

EntityName.description: The logical name of the entity.

LinkEntities.description: A collection of the links between multiple entity types.

NoLock.description: Indicates that no shared locks are issued against the data that would prohibit other transactions from modifying the data in the records re…

Orders.description: The order in which the entity instances are returned from the query.

PageInfo.description: The number of pages and the number of entity instances per page returned from the query.

QueryHints.description: A hint for generated SQL text which affects the query's execution.

SubQueryExpression.description: Defines the QueryExpression for a nested query.

TopCount.description: The number of rows to be returned.
